title: T200 Public Performance Data, 10–20 V
version: September 2019, one August 2019 unit, Basic ESC R3
finding: Six voltage sheets, each 201 pulse widths. The single-unit static load-cell experiment discards transients, averages steady readings and replaces unstable low-RPM rows with zero.
rights: Public download; workbook-specific redistribution license unverified. Group summaries and source link only.

title: T500 Public Performance Data, 12–24 V
version: August 2022, one April 2022 unit, Basic ESC 500 R1
finding: Seven voltage sheets, each 201 pulse widths. The manufacturer reports medians of filtered steady samples. The zero policy differs from T200.
rights: Public download; workbook-specific redistribution license unverified. Group summaries and source link only.

title: MATLAB and Simulink Robotics Arena: From Data to Model
version: 2018; tested File Exchange submission 65919 download versions 1 and 2, all 23 uncompressed members identical
level: measured files; command and force time series
finding: Eighteen CSVs for T100/T200, 15,001 synchronous time, pulse-width and force rows each. Positive command ranges only. The full waveform includes out-of-range sign observations.
rights: Archive license.txt permits redistribution subject to its listed conditions (BSD-style). No source files mirrored.

title: Dataset – Experimental Force Data of a Restrained ROV under Waves and Current
authors: Roman Gabl | Thomas Davey | Yu Cao | Qian Li | Boyang Li | Kyle L. Walker | Francesco Giorgio-Serchi | Simona Aracri | Aristides Kiprakis | Adam A. Stokes | David M. Ingram
level: measured files; observed independent tether loads and derived net forces
finding: ZIP catalogue 178 members. All 36 raw/processed files for Mot01–18 checked. Fixed-site contextual labels accompany the experiment; 128 Hz load-cell and optical records, no per-thruster requested/applied PWM time series in these files.
rights: CC BY 4.0 (Edinburgh DataShare / DataCite). Original creators credited.

title: Tracking Data of a Remotely Operated Vehicle and its Tether Using Underwater Motion Capture System and a Tension Sensor
authors: Juri Khanmeh | Bilal Wehbe | Enrico Simetti | Giovanni Indiveri
level: measured files; pilot/controller RC, tension and optical markers
finding: 182 archive members inventoried. Four limited cable length / 5m CSVs audited, with asynchronous stream clocks, exported alignment and missing optical positions.

title: BlueROV2 trajectory dataset
authors: Ocean Systems Laboratory (oceansystemslab); Ignacio Carlucho (commit author)
level: measured files; water-tank trajectory and raw thruster commands
finding: 39 unique canonical dataset/ CSVs. All have eight PWM channels, pose and input-force fields; the leading column is an index. The authors do not identify an external per-thruster load sensor in the README. Root demo CSV duplicates a trajectory.
rights: README calls the release open source. Pinned tree contains no explicit license; link and derived counts only.
